ko: 600년쯤 전, 중국의 명나라는 동아시아의 중심이었어요. 정화는 명 황제의 함대를 이끌고 인도양을 일곱 번 건넌 사람이에요. 28년 동안 일곱 번 떠난 함대는 왜 멈췄을까요? 그리고 정화는 왜, 무엇을 얻으려고 떠났을까요? 정화는 윈난의 무슬림 집안에서 태어났어요. 열 살 남짓에 명의 군대에 붙잡혀 환관이 됐어요. 1405년 첫 함대가 떠났어요. 기록에는 2만 7천 명 넘게 탔다고 적혀 있어요.
en: About six hundred years ago, Ming China was the center of East Asia. Zheng He led the Ming emperor's fleet across the Indian Ocean seven times. Why did a fleet that sailed seven times in twenty-eight years stop? And why did Zheng He go, and what did he hope to gain? Zheng He was born into a Muslim family in Yunnan. At about ten, he was captured by the Ming army and made a eunuch. In 1405, the first fleet set sail. The records say more than 27,000 people were on board.
id: Sekitar enam ratus tahun yang lalu, Dinasti Ming di Tiongkok adalah pusat Asia Timur. Zheng He memimpin armada kaisar Ming menyeberangi Samudra Hindia sebanyak tujuh kali. Mengapa armada yang berlayar tujuh kali dalam dua puluh delapan tahun itu berhenti? Dan mengapa Zheng He berangkat, apa yang ingin ia dapatkan? Zheng He lahir dari keluarga Muslim di Yunnan. Sekitar umur sepuluh tahun, ia ditangkap tentara Ming dan dijadikan kasim. Pada tahun 1405, armada pertama berlayar. Catatan menyebut lebih dari 27.000 orang ikut di dalamnya.
